title: DevTrack
description: A developer productivity platform for tracking coding activity, managing workflows, and monitoring developer progress. Built GitHub integration, analytics dashboards, Kanban task management, and secure authentication using modern web technologies.

title: Mula
description: A personal finance application designed to help users manage expenses and understand their spending habits. Developed a mobile experience with secure authentication, expense tracking features, REST APIs, PostgreSQL database design, and scalable backend services.

title: RecipeFlow
description: A full-stack recipe sharing platform with user authentication, recipe management, and media handling. Designed REST APIs, implemented email verification, integrated Cloudinary for image storage, and built responsive user interfaces.

title: Livora
description: A cross-platform real estate application focused on simplifying property discovery and management. Built mobile interfaces, integrated backend APIs, and implemented features including property listings, user profiles, authentication, and communication features.

title: Smart Poultry (PMSyst)
description: A poultry farm management application that helps monitor farming activities and growth records. Developed mobile interfaces and integrated backend APIs to support efficient farm data management.
